scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/api run dev:worker" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.test: npm -w packages/shared run test && npm -w apps/api run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w packages/shared run typecheck && npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
